subject: GOBACK statement
notes: Both halves of the rule are implemented and each has a GOBACK-specific pin. The VALUE reaches the OS: 'GOBACK WITH ERROR STATUS 5.' -> 5, 'GOBACK WITH ERROR STATUS "007".' -> 7 and '... STATUS WS-DISPLAY.' -> 7 are InlineData rows on the GOBACK arm, and the flush happens runtime-side in the RunUnit.ExitStatus setter so it crosses assembly boundaries. 'Any constraints on the value ... are defined by the implementor' is the required 4.2.16 documentation and docs/CONFORMANCE.md items 192/193 supply it in full (integer truncated toward zero; a non-numeric operand decoded through CobolNum.FromAlphanumeric with a non-digit position contributing no digit - so 'ABEND' maps to 0 - plus the two host clamps: narrowing to Int32 and a POSIX host's low 8 bits). The rule's 'IN A MAIN PROGRAM' restriction is enforced by the !__asCalled guard and measured in BOTH non-main contexts: a CALLed subprogram's status is inert (CalledSubprogramGobackStatus_IsInert) and a user-defined FUNCTION's is too (probe gr10fn/fnstatus exits 0).  || CODE SITES (verbatim from the adjudication, kept because the schema's code-location is symbol-keyed, not line-keyed): src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/CodeGen/Emit/NumericRenderer.cs#ExitStatus + #StatusNum; src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/CodeGen/Verbs/CallEmitter.cs#EmitGoback (the !__asCalled main-program guard); src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/Control/RunUnit.cs#ExitStatus setter
